notes_for_implementer: This fixture adds a genuinely NEW failure mode beyond fixture 05: because the original Russian section titles contain non-ASCII characters, this MediaWiki snapshot generates an additional legacy empty anchor <span id='...'> (percent-encoded UTF-8 bytes of the Cyrillic title) BEFORE the real mw-headline span, inside the same heading tag.
